facts.text: Merchants appear on set stages, grouped into tiers by stage range. A compass icon next to the stage number shows whether one is active.
They sell slime heroes for gems, plus lucky tickets, equipment, keys and arena tickets.
Only Gandalfu Slime and Queen Slime give an ATK multiplier.
Lucky tickets cost 500-1,000 gems and items are free 10-20% of the time.
The named merchants in the original drafts (Boran the Peddler, Alchemist Zephyr, Celestial Nomad Stella) and their 4/6/8 hour cadences do not exist.
